name: Roska Upholstery
old_description: Welcome to the world of custom upholstery services! Here, we transform your furniture into stunning pieces that reflect your unique style and personality. Our skilled craftsmen are dedicated to providing high-quality materials and exceptional workmanship, ensuring your satisfaction every step of the way. Let us help you create the perfect look for your home!
about:
Roska Upholstery operates from Watertown, Connecticut. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year, ownership structure, or the names of its founders.

The shop provides custom upholstery and furniture repair services, including reassembly of broken parts, frame reinforcement and re-webbing, and full reupholstery with new fabric and padding. In addition to restoration work, Roska manufactures new furniture pieces such as ottomans, valances, headboards, and chests to customer specifications, and also produces custom cushions, bathroom linen sets, and kitchen linen sets. The company notes that clients can bring in designs from magazines or online for consideration.

The company serves residential, commercial, and healthcare clients, with project galleries showing work for homes, businesses, and medical facilities. Outdoor and indoor cushion fabrication and repurposed furniture restoration are also offered. The business occasionally sells handmade craft items through its showroom.

Roska emphasizes skilled craftsmanship, high-quality materials, and exceptional workmanship as the foundation of its service, aiming to transform furniture into pieces that reflect each client’s unique style. The company was started to provide personalized upholstery solutions, though the specific founding story is not detailed publicly.
